module Book::Accessable
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern

  included do
    has_many :accesses, dependent: :destroy
    scope :with_everyone_access, -> { where(everyone_access: true) }
  end

  class_methods do
    def accessable_or_published(user: Current.user)
      if user.present?
        accessable_or_published_books
      else
        published
      end
    end

    def accessable_or_published_books(user: Current.user)
      user.books.or(published).distinct
    end
  end

  def accessable?(user: Current.user)
    accesses.exists?(user: user)
  end

  def editable?(user: Current.user)
    access_for(user: user)&.editor? || user&.administrator?
  end

  def access_for(user: Current.user)
    accesses.find_by(user: user)
  end

  def update_access(editors:, readers:)
    editors = Set.new(editors)
    readers = Set.new(everyone_access? ? User.active.ids : readers)

    all = editors + readers
    all_accesses = all.collect { |user_id|
      { user_id: user_id, level: editors.include?(user_id) ? :editor : :reader }
    }

    accesses.upsert_all(all_accesses, unique_by: [ :book_id, :user_id ])
    accesses.where.not(user_id: all).delete_all
  end
end

class Book::AccessImport
  Result = Struct.new(:accesses, :duplicate_index)

  def initialize(book, grants)
    @book, @grants = book, grants
  end

  def import
    grants = @grants.to_a
    return Result.new([], nil) if grants.empty?

    if (invalid_index = first_invalid_index(grants))
      return Result.new([], invalid_index)
    end

    rows = grants.map do |grant|
      { user_id: cast_user_id(grant[:user_id]), level: grant[:level].to_s }
    end

    accesses = insert_accesses(rows, grants)
    return Result.new([], duplicate_index_from_db(grants)) unless accesses

    accesses.each do |access|
      Book::AccessNotificationJob.perform_later(access)
    end

    Result.new(accesses, nil)
  end

  private
    def first_invalid_index(grants)
      user_ids = grants.filter_map { |grant| cast_user_id(grant[:user_id]) }.uniq
      existing_user_ids = user_ids.empty? ? Set.new : @book.accesses.where(user_id: user_ids).pluck(:user_id).to_set
      seen_user_ids = Set.new

      grants.each_with_index do |grant, index|
        return index unless Access.levels.key?(grant[:level].to_s)

        user_id = cast_user_id(grant[:user_id])
        return index if user_id && (existing_user_ids.include?(user_id) || !seen_user_ids.add?(user_id))
      end

      nil
    end

    def insert_accesses(rows, grants)
      ids = nil

      Access.transaction(requires_new: true) do
        ids = @book.accesses.insert_all!(rows).rows.flatten
      end

      accesses_by_user_id = @book.accesses.where(id: ids).index_by(&:user_id)
      grants.map { |grant| accesses_by_user_id.fetch(cast_user_id(grant[:user_id])) }
    rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique
      nil
    end

    def duplicate_index_from_db(grants)
      user_ids = grants.filter_map { |grant| cast_user_id(grant[:user_id]) }.uniq
      existing_user_ids = @book.accesses.where(user_id: user_ids).pluck(:user_id).to_set
      grants.index { |grant| existing_user_ids.include?(cast_user_id(grant[:user_id])) }
    end

    def cast_user_id(user_id)
      Access.type_for_attribute(:user_id).cast(user_id)
    end
end
